# HAND-BUILT FIXTURE — written from the ruled table `zypper list-updates`
# (zypper(8): "list-updates (lu) [options] — List available updates"; with the
# global `-q` the "Loading repository data..." and "Reading installed
# packages..." notices are what a quiet run still tends to leave in front of
# the table, and the parser ignores any line without a column separator). It is
# not a transcript of a real system's output: no row below was recorded from a
# running openSUSE install, and the versions were written by hand to be
# plausible for a rolling Tumbleweed snapshot.
#
# Still owed before this format can be called field-proven: a real run on
# openSUSE Tumbleweed, recorded with `LC_ALL=C zypper --non-interactive -q lu >
# fixture.txt`, checked against the exact header zypper prints for this release.
# The column set below is one of the two layouts this parser is written to
# tolerate — a Status column after New Version — chosen deliberately so the
# test suite covers it; which columns a given zypper build prints is exactly
# what the real recording still has to confirm.
#
# The `|`-separated columns are read by header name, not by position, and
# `New Version` is what a deployment installs. zypper reports no severity and
# no category here (those belong to its patch listing), so nothing invents one.
Loading repository data...
Reading installed packages...

v | openSUSE-Tumbleweed-Oss | libssl3           | 3.5.1-2.1       | 3.6.0-1.1         |
v | openSUSE-Tumbleweed-Update | curl           | 8.19.0-3.1      | 8.20.0-1.1        |
v | openSUSE-Tumbleweed-Oss | kernel-default    | 6.17.4-1.1      | 6.17.7-1.1        |
